acme-engineer: Hi, hit a regression after today's rollout. Invoice summaries are missing line items and sometimes show the wrong currency symbol. This started after ~09:12 UTC deploy. Internal perf/eval dashboards show no regressions.

lina-cs: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact prompt and one example of the bad output + expected output? also paste the request_id from the response if you have it.

acme-engineer: request_id=req_0a1b2c3d, prompt attached below.

acme-engineer: ```
System: Summarize the invoice below into line items (description, qty, unit_price, currency) and total.
User: Invoice: "3 x Widget A @ $10, 2 x Widget B @ €5"
Expected: two line items, currencies preserved as input.
Got: single line with combined qty and $ present for both.
```

sam-ml: thanks. first quick checks: which model variant + revision did the customer hit? also, did they use any custom system or user messages/metadata?

acme-engineer: header includes model: rwd-3b-instruct-v2, revision: 2026-03-15-0911 (looks like the rollout revision). No custom system beyond the prompt block.

derek-eng: ops-bot shows deployment: "deploy-bot: deployed rwd-3b-instruct-v2 @ 2026-03-15T09:12:08Z (rev 2026-03-15-0911)" — matches their time.

sam-ml: ok. internal eval harness (eval-runner) used our canonical invoice evalset which passed for rev 2026-03-15-0911?

derek-eng: that's right — CI-eval shows 97.8% pass on invoice set (same seed, deterministic).

sam-ml: so we have an eval mismatch: internal evals pass, customer prompt fails. Common causes: (1) tokenization differences when prompts include quotes/hidden NBSPs, (2) minor decoder sampling config differences between internal eval runner and production (e.g., temperature or top_k override), (3) system prompt concatenation / truncation in real requests, (4) a model alias routing to a quantized variant for larger requests.

lina-cs: acme, quick check — can you confirm you didn't post-process the response or pipe through your own normalization? sometimes frontend replaces € with $.

acme-engineer: no post-processing, we verified raw payload from our server. here's full response body (trimmed):

```
{"request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d","model":"rwd-3b-instruct-v2","output":"Line items: Widget A x5 $10 Total: $50"}
```

sam-ml: hmm that output looks like currencies got normalized to dollars and quantities merged. Can you run the same prompt against the canary endpoint (rwd-3b-instruct-v2@canary) with same headers? if you can't, we can run it on our side.

derek-eng: also capture tokenization: run `python -c "from rwd_tokenizer import toks; print(toks(prompt))"` and paste token ids — differences here would indicate NBSP or unicode variants.

acme-engineer: ran canary — request_id=req_canary_77, canarys output matches prod (bad). token ids attached: `101, 45, 3001, 2, 999` (they look same at a glance).

sam-ml: ok so not tokenization. Next: check request-level generation params returned in logs (temperature, top_p, max_tokens). Derek, can we pull the inference record for req_0a1b2c3d?

derek-eng: pulling... `logs: find_infer --id req_0a1b2c3d --show-config --show-kv` -> 
```
model: rwd-3b-instruct-v2
revision: 2026-03-15-0911
temperature: 0.0
top_p: 1.0
max_tokens: 256
quantization: int8
kv_cache_hit: 12
```

sam-ml: temperature 0.0 deterministic — same as eval harness. quantization:int8 though. Did eval-runner use int8 quantized variant? I think our evaluation used FP16 runtime. That could be a factor.

lina-cs: does quantization change token collapse/merging?

sam-ml: usually not for simple formatting, but it can slightly change logits and decoding when there's tight decision boundaries. But the change from preserving currency to normalizing to $ seems odd. Could be model patch that adjusted token->string mapping in detokenizer or server-side normalization (legacy fallback to USD).

derek-eng: I'll grep deploy config for any recent normalization middleware introduced in rev 2026-03-15-0911.

ops-bot: audit-log: "normalizer-service" config changed at 2026-03-15T09:10Z: add_currency_heuristic=true by config owner @infra.

acme-engineer: wait we didn't change anything on our side. If a normalizer is changing currencies, that's a regression.

derek-eng: confirmed: the new normalizer heuristics are part of the rollout. It runs post-detokenization on outputs for a small subset of customers for currency inference experiments. Looks like acme matched the bucket.

sam-ml: that explains it. Why didn't eval-runner catch it? our eval harness receives raw model outputs before normalizer; the production path runs the normalizer post-process, so the internal metric looked fine.

lina-cs: oh nice catch. so mismatch = eval harness instrumented earlier in pipeline. We should (a) add a production-like postprocess step to the eval harness, (b) roll back normalizer for affected customers / turn off add_currency_heuristic, and (c) run a focused repro on canary that toggles normalizer.

derek-eng: agreed. immediate plan: flip feature flag for normalizer for acme to off, deploy config rollback in 5m, notify acme. Also open a postmortem for the deployment gating.

oncall-ml: I'll run a diffs job: run customer's prompt with and without normalizer and produce token-level diffs + loglik traces. sam, can you add this to the eval suite for regression detection?

sam-ml: will do — add a step to pipe canonical post-processing (detokenize -> normalizer -> final) in CI and assert no semantic changes on synthetic invoice tests.

lina-cs: acme, sorry for the impact. We'll flip the flag now and check your request again. We'll follow up with a timeline and RCA.

acme-engineer: thanks, appreciate the fast turnaround. can you confirm whether any billing or quota was affected? we saw a small increase in token usage but not sure if related.

derek-eng: normalizer added ~3 tokens of metadata in some paths but shouldn't affect billing significantly. we'll include any delta in the follow-up.

ops-bot: config-change: turned_off add_currency_heuristic for customer=acme-corp at 2026-03-15T09:46Z by @infra.

acme-engineer: can confirm new requests after 09:47 UTC look correct. thanks all.

lina-cs: closing loop: we'll (1) ship eval harness change this week, (2) add a synthetic test covering currency heuristics, (3) follow up with formal RCA and customer note. tagging sam/derek for postmortem. :thumbsup:

sam-ml: tracking issue created: #INF-8421 "eval harness postprocess parity + currency normalizer fallout". assigning to sam-ml/derek-eng.

acme-engineer: thanks again. can you share the RCA when ready?

lina-cs: yes — we'll send the RCA + mitigation steps within 48h and add a timeline in the ticket.

oncall-ml: putting logs + diffs in the ticket now.

ops-bot: thread archived after resolution (auto)."
